meta.name: gguf-quantization
meta.description: GGUF format and llama.cpp quantization for efficient CPU/GPU inference. Use when deploying models on consumer hardware, Apple Silicon, or when needing flexible quantization from 2-8 bit without GPU requirements.

copy.tagline: 将模型量化为GGUF格式，在消费级硬件上高效推理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在普通电脑或苹果芯片上运行大模型
copy.tagline_en: Quantize models to GGUF format for efficient inference on consumer hardware
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run large models on ordinary computers or Apple Silicon

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude指导你如何将AI模型转换为GGUF格式，并用llama.cpp进行量化压缩，以便在普通电脑、苹果芯片等设备上高效运行。
howto.when: 当你需要将HuggingFace模型部署到本地设备，或想调整模型量化精度（2-8位）以平衡性能和大小。

say.text: 帮我把这个模型量化成Q4_K_M格式。
say.note: Claude会给出转换和量化的命令步骤。

say.text: 如何在苹果M2芯片上优化模型推理？
say.note: Claude会提供Metal加速的构建和运行方法。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to guide you in converting AI models to GGUF format and quantizing them with llama.cpp for efficient inference on consumer hardware, Apple Silicon, and CPUs.
howto.when_en: When you need to deploy a HuggingFace model locally or adjust quantization levels (2-8 bit) to balance performance and size.

say_en.text: Help me quantize this model to Q4_K_M.
say_en.note: Claude will provide conversion and quantization commands.

say_en.text: How to optimize model inference on Apple M2?
say_en.note: Claude will provide Metal acceleration build and run steps.
